name: application-sync-status-row
title: Sync Status Row
description: Last-synced status row with a real three-state icon (spinning while syncing, checkmark on success, warning on error) and a manual Sync now action.
useWhen: Showing the state of a background sync process (e.g. cloud backup, integration polling) alongside when it last ran.
Users need a manual way to trigger a sync outside the automatic schedule.
The sync can genuinely fail and users need to see that distinctly from "in progress" or "done".
avoidWhen: The operation is a one-off user action, not a recurring background process — use save-status-indicator instead.
There's no manual retry/sync affordance needed — a plain timestamp label is simpler.
The process has multiple discrete sub-steps to show — use a progress bar or stepper instead of a single status row.
responsiveBehavior: The row is a single flex line that fits naturally in a settings panel or integration card at any width.
accessibility: The row carries role='status' so screen readers announce state changes (syncing → synced/failed) without interrupting.
State is conveyed by icon shape and a text label together (Syncing…/Synced/Sync failed), not color alone.
The Sync now button is disabled (not hidden) while a sync is in progress, avoiding duplicate concurrent syncs.

variants.title: Sync status row
variants.description: Synced, Syncing, and Sync failed states stacked to show all three, on a light surface.
accessibility: The Sync now button is disabled during the syncing state to prevent overlapping sync requests.

variants.title: Sync status row (Dark)
variants.description: The same three states, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Icon and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
